definitions.explanation: Items worn on the body for decoration, including rings, necklaces, earrings, brooches, and other ornamental accessories. A somewhat formal, comprehensive term.

examples.japanese: {装身具|そうしんぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}につける→身につける：03158_minitsukeru⟧。
{金|きん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{装身具|そうしんぐ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{光|ひか}っていた→光る：01163_hikaru⟧。

⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧エジプト⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{装身具|そうしんぐ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: Ancient Egyptian jewelry draws large crowds even in art museums.

notes:
Composed of {装|そう} (adorn) + {身|しん} (body) + ⟦{具|ぐ}→具：07857_gu⟧ (implement, tool). Literally "body-adorning implements."

USAGE:
{装身具|そうしんぐ} is a formal, umbrella term for all types of personal ornaments. In everyday conversation, ⟦アクセサリー→アクセサリー：01761_akusesarii⟧ is far more common. {装身具|そうしんぐ} appears in written language — museum descriptions, historical texts, product catalogs, and formal writing. It covers everything from jewelry to hair ornaments and decorative brooches.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {装身具|そうしんぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}につける→身につける：03158_minitsukeru⟧: to wear accessories
- {装身具|そうしんぐ}⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧: jewelry/accessory shop
- {金|きん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{装身具|そうしんぐ}: gold jewelry
- ⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{装身具|そうしんぐ}: ancient ornaments

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦アクセサリー→アクセサリー：01761_akusesarii⟧: accessories — the everyday word for fashion accessories and jewelry
- ⟦{宝飾品|ほうしょくひん}→宝飾品：22333_houshokuhin⟧: jewelry, precious ornaments — emphasizes precious stones and metals; higher-end than general {装身具|そうしんぐ}
- ⟦ジュエリー→ジュエリー：25591_juerii⟧: jewelry — a loanword focusing on fine jewelry with precious materials
